Consequently the complete integer relation lattice is generated by \((1,-1,0,-1)\), so the phase-flow closure is the stated three-torus. No off-diagonal phase-difference character lies in its annihilator, hence Haar barycenter is zero and is relative-interior. The positive density \(1-(\lambda/4)(\cos3\xi+\cos6\xi+\cos9\xi)\), \(1<\lambda<4/3\), therefore realizes \(\lambda\) times exactly the forced coherence vector. Convex interpolation with the Haar barycenter puts the target in the relative interior of the phase hull; density of the actual time orbit and the equality of relative interiors of a convex set and its closure yield an actual finite time mixture. The frozen verifier reconstructs \(J/8\) from the forced coherences and checks all frequency identities; its floating checks are corroborative, while the exact algebra above proves the theorem.
